what: On a board tilted −12°, rows of four color bars (360×72) rise one row at a time every 120 frames (2 seconds at 60Hz) from 72px below in .75s, stacking a staircase toward the upper right (the whole board drifts 120px left and is pushed 72px up per row over 1s). Two arrow lines, orange and yellow, take turns drawing a rounded-corner staircase path in 4 seconds as they climb (inOutCubic). On every even row a soft shadow under the bars turns on in .75s. On open, 12 rows are laid at once and it starts, and it pauses off screen. A bar never gets the same color as its neighbor

options.cols: Bar column count per row, default 4
options.w: Width of one bar cell (px), default 360 — each row shifts sideways by a third of this, forming steps
options.rows: Number of lines to keep, default 6
options.prefill: Number of rows pre-laid on open, default 12
options.--fx-stair-1~6: Bar color (css), default is six steps mixing the accent with ink and background
options.--fx-stair-under: Color of the empty area below the panel (css), default --kf-bg

use: — The user sets the height. The panel grows from the element’s bottom-right corner, so put the text at the top left.

from.where: index.html .dt-stripe — original stripe section Brand (skewY(-12) panel · line .75s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) · panel 1s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1) · 120 frames/line · 6 lines kept · 12 lines pre-laid · line inOutCubic). The original shadow png was redrawn as a blurred bar (feGaussianBlur)

note: Counted in frames rather than time, as in the original — on a 120Hz screen it builds up twice as fast (same in the original)
